title: Signs and Notices
description: Read the sign or notice and choose the correct meaning.

questions.sign_text: A circular prohibition sign with a thick red border and diagonal slash over a black silhouette icon of an outside food container and soda can, on a clean white background, filling 90% of the square canvas, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign mean?
options: Free festival food is served inside this pavilion every afternoon.
Please purchase all your take-away food outside the main pavilion.
Visitors must not bring outside food into this dining pavilion.
Leaving unfinished food on pavilion dining tables is prohibited.
questions.correct_answer: Visitors must not bring outside food into this dining pavilion.

questions.sign_text: A circular prohibition sign with a thick red border and diagonal slash over a black camera silhouette with a prominent lightning bolt flash symbol, on a clean white background, filling 90% of the square canvas, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign mean?
options: Visitors may take photos using flashlights throughout the gallery.
Do not touch the ancient silk textiles while taking gallery photos.
Please charge your digital camera batteries outside of the gallery.
Flash photography is strictly prohibited inside the textile gallery.
questions.correct_answer: Flash photography is strictly prohibited inside the textile gallery.

questions.sign_text: A circular mandatory action sign with a deep blue background showing a crisp white symbol of clean white socks and removed shoes placed neatly aside, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign mean?
options: Wearing clean white socks without shoes is prohibited in the room.
Guests are required to remove their shoes before entering the room.
You can purchase traditional souvenir shoes inside the tea room.
Please keep your outdoor shoes on while walking through the room.
questions.correct_answer: Guests are required to remove their shoes before entering the room.

questions.sign_text: A triangular warning sign with a bright yellow background and black border showing a black silhouette icon of a person's foot caught between two horizontal colliding poles, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign say?
options: Watch out for fast-moving poles while trying the bamboo dance.
Dancing with heavy wooden shoes on the bamboo floor is advised.
Visitors must avoid watching the traditional bamboo dance show.
Stepping onto the stage without bamboo poles is strictly banned.
questions.correct_answer: Watch out for fast-moving poles while trying the bamboo dance.

questions.sign_text: A triangular warning sign with a bright yellow background and black border showing three stylized black flame icons above a red chili pepper silhouette, centered and filling 90% of the square canvas, NO text or words of any kind.
questions.question: What does the sign say?
options: Be careful because this specialty dish contains extremely hot peppers.
Fresh chili peppers can be purchased at this ethnic specialty counter.
Do not add any dried chili peppers to this traditional specialty dish.
Cooking this hot specialty dish over open flames is strictly forbidden.
questions.correct_answer: Be careful because this specialty dish contains extremely hot peppers.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, no floating devices or walls, large high-contrast typography, dark bronze metallic plaque texture, bold gold title 'FOLK MUSIC RECITAL IN PROGRESS', subtext 'Silence please - do not enter while performers are playing', maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the sign say?
options: The recital has been canceled because several musicians arrived late.
We must remain quiet and wait outside until the performance concludes.
Audience members can enter the recital hall whenever performers pause.
Playing folk instruments inside the recital lobby is strictly allowed.
questions.correct_answer: We must remain quiet and wait outside until the performance concludes.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, no floating devices or walls, large high-contrast typography, textured yellow notepad paper texture, clear handwritten script: 'Hi Lan, I collected our traditional parade costumes from the tailor. Please bring the embroidered headdresses to rehearsal at 4 p.m. - Minh', maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the note say?
options: Minh wants Lan to bring the traditional headdresses to the rehearsal.
The tailor canceled their appointment for fitting the new costumes.
Minh will deliver the embroidered headdresses directly to the tailor.
Lan needs to pick up the parade costumes from the tailor at 4 p.m.
questions.correct_answer: Minh wants Lan to bring the traditional headdresses to the rehearsal.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, no floating devices or walls, large high-contrast typography, modern clean email interface layout, header 'To: Exchange Students | Subject: Cultural Orientation Day', body 'Dear students, bring a small cultural souvenir or traditional snack from your home country to share at tomorrow's welcoming circle.', maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the email say?
options: The welcoming circle has been postponed until all souvenirs arrive.
Students should bring a traditional cultural item to share tomorrow.
Exchange students must purchase their cultural snacks at the campus.
Only students with traditional costumes can attend the orientation.
questions.correct_answer: Students should bring a traditional cultural item to share tomorrow.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, no floating devices or walls, large high-contrast typography, vibrant festival flyer layout with warm festive colors, headline 'GLOBAL TASTE PASS', text 'Taste 5 international food stalls for the price of 4! Valid only before 5 p.m. on festival weekdays.', maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the notice tell us?
options: Festival passes are completely valid for unlimited meals on weekend nights.
The global food festival opens four new international stalls every weekend.
Buying five food passes grants a special discount for late evening dinners.
Visitors can receive one free food stall tasting before 5 p.m. on weekdays.
questions.correct_answer: Visitors can receive one free food stall tasting before 5 p.m. on weekdays.

questions.sign_text: Full-bleed square graphic design, 100% edge-to-edge layout filling the entire square image canvas with zero outer background margins, no floating devices or walls, large high-contrast typography, artistic festival poster layout with colorful folk carnival masks, headline 'CARNIVAL MASK WORKSHOP', body 'Saturday 2 p.m. at Youth Center. All craft materials provided. Advance registration required via student portal.', maximum readability when printed.
questions.question: What does the notice tell us?
options: The carnival mask workshop takes place every Saturday morning at the club.
Free carnival costumes will be distributed to everyone visiting the center.
Participants must sign up online before attending the carnival craft class.
Students need to bring their own paper and paint to the youth center class.
questions.correct_answer: Participants must sign up online before attending the carnival craft class.
